title: Record what you turned down
why: A registry of what was adopted answers half the question. Without a record of what was rejected and why, the same candidate gets re-proposed every few months and re-evaluated from scratch, and the reasoning that killed it the first time is gone.
fix: Add a Declined section to the same rules file, with the tool, the date and one sentence on what disqualified it. A permanent refusal should be as easy to look up as an approval.
